descriptions.text: BIT Mining reports that its subsidiary, cryptocurrency mining pool BTC.com, suffered a “cyber attack” on Dec. 3, in which the attackers stole approximately $700,000 in customer assets and $2.3 million in company assets . However, they said some of the funds had been recovered.

BTC.com, a major cryptocurrency mining pool, suffered a cyberattack on December 3, 2022, resulting in the loss of approximately $3 million in company and client funds across Bitcoin and Ethereum assets. The breach exploited weaknesses in infrastructure security and key management; no contract or on-chain exploit code is identified in public records. Attackers gained unauthorized access to BTC.com infrastructure, enabling theft of hot wallet keys or administrator credentials. This allowed direct unauthorized withdrawal of assets. The precise method of access (e.g., malware, social engineering, or direct server exploit) is not disclosed.
